title: Delete stays disabled while only an open part request or a part return uses the entry
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop; locations Staging Heavy Duty and Staging Lethbridge). Current location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin (or a default Parts Manager): Part Library & Inventory View, Create & Edit and Delete, and See Financial Data. Data: SO = the part number of the seeded special-order request received within the last 12 months (work at the location that received it, Staging Heavy Duty assumed). Its entry has no inventory part behind it and no open request, so Delete starts enabled. An open work order at that location; the vendor that supplied SO.
custom_steps:
1. Parts > Part Library > open SO's entry > pencil, and hover Delete.
  2. On the open work order: Add Part > type SO > pick the option with the subtitle "Part Library · {vendor}" > add it with qty 1 so it is saved as a part request. Do not order or receive it.
  3. Reload SO's entry detail page > pencil > hover Delete.
  4. Order and receive that part request in full (through its purchase order), then reload SO's entry detail page > pencil.
  5. From the work order, create a return of the received SO part to its vendor and leave the return not completed; reload SO's entry detail page > pencil > hover Delete.
  6. Complete the return; reload SO's entry detail page > pencil.
custom_expected:
1. Delete is enabled; no tooltip (only a received line uses the entry).
  2. The work order shows an open part request for SO; no inventory part is created at the location.
  3. Delete is disabled and hovering shows "Part cannot be deleted. Please delete related parts first." although no inventory part uses the entry.
  4. The request shows as received on the work order; after the reload Delete is enabled again.
  5. Delete is disabled with the same hover text "Part cannot be deleted. Please delete related parts first." while the return is not completed.
  6. Delete is enabled again; no tooltip. (Do not delete the entry.)
